DECLARE @SITE VARCHAR(30) = '{0}'; DECLARE @DOCNUM VARCHAR(30) = '%{1}%'; DECLARE @ITMDES NVARCHAR(300) = '%{2}%'; DECLARE @DATSTR DATE = '{3}'; DECLARE @DATEND DATE = '{4}'; DECLARE @DEPT VARCHAR(30) = '{5}'; DECLARE @ITMNO VARCHAR(30) = '%{6}%';
-- 使用 CTE 提高可读性 WITH ORDER_LINES AS ( -- 合并询价和直接订单的逻辑 SELECT COALESCE(PL.DOCNUM, PRQL.DOCNUM) AS SRC_DOCNUM, COALESCE(PL.DOCLIN, PRQL.DOCLIN) AS SRC_DOCLIN, COALESCE(PL.ITMNO, PRQL.ITMNO) AS ITMNO, PRQL.PINNUM, PH.DOCDAT AS PINDAT, D1.DOCNUM AS POR_NUM_FROM_PIN, D1.DOCLIN AS POR_LIN_FROM_PIN, D2.DOCNUM AS POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ, D2.DOCLIN AS POR_LIN_FROM_PRQ, PRQL.DOCNUM, PRQL.DOCLIN FROM PREQUL PRQL LEFT JOIN PINQUL PL ON PL.DOCNUM = PRQL.PINNUM AND PL.ITMNO = PRQL.ITMNO LEFT JOIN PINQUH PH ON PH.DOCNUM =PL.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN PORDLIN D1 ON PL.DOCNUM = D1.SRCDOC AND PL.DOCLIN = D1.SRCLIN AND D1.SRCTYP = 'PIN' LEFT JOIN PORDLIN D2 ON PRQL.DOCNUM = D2.SRCDOC AND PRQL.DOCLIN = D2.SRCLIN AND D2.SRCTYP = 'PRQ' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PREQAL S WHERE S.PRQNUM = PRQL.DOCNUM AND (@ITMNO = '%' OR S.ITMNO LIKE @ITMNO) ) ), POR_DETAILS AS ( -- 订单相关信息的聚合 SELECT PD.POR_NUM, PD.POR_LIN, MIN(PBH.DOCNUM) AS PBHNUM, MIN(PBH.DOCDAT) AS PBHDAT, MIN(PBH.ETD) AS ETD, MIN(PBH.ETA) AS ETA, MIN(PBH.BLD) AS BLD, MIN(PRC.DOCNUM) AS PRCDOC, MIN(PRC.SUBTIM) AS PRCDAT FROM ( SELECT POR_NUM_FROM_PIN AS POR_NUM, POR_LIN_FROM_PIN AS POR_LIN FROM ORDER_LINES WHERE POR_NUM_FROM_PIN IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ AS POR_NUM, POR_LIN_FROM_PRQ AS POR_LIN FROM ORDER_LINES WHERE POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ IS NOT NULL ) PD LEFT JOIN PBOLD PBL ON PBL.SRCDOC = PD.POR_NUM AND PBL.SRCLIN = PD.POR_LIN AND PBL.SRCTYP = 'POR' LEFT JOIN PBOLH PBH ON PBH.DOCNUM = PBL.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN PRECLIN PRC ON PRC.SRCDOC = PD.POR_NUM AND PRC.SRCLIN = PD.POR_LIN AND PRC.SRCTYP = 'POR' GROUP BY PD.POR_NUM, PD.POR_LIN ), MAIN_QUERY AS ( SELECT TOP 500 S.ID AS LINKROWID, S.DOCNUM, S.DOCLIN, S.ITMNO, ITM.ITMNAM, ITM.ITMNAM1, ITM.ITMNAM2, S.ITMVER, ITM.TSICOD1, ITM.TSICOD2, ITM.TSICOD3, ITM.TSICOD4, ITM.TSICOD5, ITM.ITMSIZE, ITM.ITMSPEC, CONVERT(VARCHAR, S.REQDAT, 23) AS REQDAT, S.UOM, S.UOMCOE, CAST(S.QTY AS REAL) AS QTY, S.STU, CAST(S.QTYSTU AS REAL) AS QTYSTU, CAST(S.PRQQTY AS REAL) AS PRQQTY, CAST(S.PRQQTYSTU AS REAL) AS PRQQTYSTU, S.REMARK AS LREMARK, S.SRCTYP, S.SRCDOC, S.SRCLIN, DOCSTA.OPTDES AS DOCSTA, S.CLOREA AS LCLOREA, H.DOCGRP, DOCGRP.OPTDES AS DOCGRPDES, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), H.DOCDAT, 21) AS DOCDAT, H.DOCDES, H.PRJNUM, H.SITE, H.DEPT, D.DEPTNAM AS DEPTDES, H.GRP, G.GRPNAM AS GRPDES, H.RESNO, R.RESNAM AS RESNODES, H.REMARK, CASE WHEN S.PRQNUM IS NULL OR S.PRQNUM = '' THEN '未申请' ELSE S.PRQNUM END AS PRQNUM, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PRQH.DOCDAT, 21) AS PRQDAT, CASE WHEN OL.PINNUM IS NULL AND PD.PBHNUM IS NULL THEN '未询价' WHEN OL.PINNUM IS NULL AND PD.PBHNUM IS NOT NULL THEN '直接生成订单' ELSE OL.PINNUM END AS PINNUM, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), OL.PINDAT, 21) AS PINDAT, CASE WHEN OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PIN IS NULL AND OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ IS NULL THEN '未采购' WHEN OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PIN IS NOT NULL AND OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ IS NULL THEN OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PIN ELSE OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ END AS PORNUM, CASE WHEN OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PIN IS NOT NULL AND OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ IS NULL THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), POR1.DOCDAT, 21) ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), POR2.DOCDAT, 21) END AS PORDAT, PD.PBHNUM, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PD.PBHDAT, 21) AS PBHDAT, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PD.ETD, 21) AS ETD, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PD.ETA, 21) AS ETA, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PD.BLD, 21) AS BLD, PD.PRCDOC, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PD.PRCDAT, 21) AS PRCDAT, S.CREUSR, S.UPDUSR, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.CRETIM, 21) AS CRETIM, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) AS UPDTIM FROM PREQAL S INNER JOIN PREQAH H ON S.DOCNUM = H.DOCNUM INNER JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN PREQUH PRQH ON PRQH.DOCNUM = S.PRQNUM LEFT JOIN ORDER_LINES OL ON OL.DOCNUM=S.PRQNUM AND OL.ITMNO=S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN PORDER POR1 ON POR1.DOCNUM = OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PIN LEFT JOIN PORDER POR2 ON POR2.DOCNUM = OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ LEFT JOIN POR_DETAILS PD ON PD.POR_NUM = COALESCE(OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PIN, OL.POR_NUM_FROM_PRQ) AND PD.POR_LIN=COALESCE(OL.POR_LIN_FROM_PIN, OL.POR_LIN_FROM_PRQ) LEFT JOIN ENTDEPT D ON H.DEPT = D.DEPT LEFT JOIN ENTGRP G ON H.GRP = G.GRP LEFT JOIN ENTRES R ON H.RESNO = R.RESNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCGRP ON H.DOCGRP = DOCGRP.OPTID AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'PRA' WHERE H.SITE = @SITE AND (@DOCNUM = '%' OR S.DOCNUM LIKE @DOCNUM) AND (@ITMNO = '%' OR S.ITMNO LIKE @ITMNO) AND (@ITMDES = '%' OR (S.ITMVER + ITM.ITMNAM + ITM.ITMNAM1) LIKE @ITMDES) AND H.DOCDAT BETWEEN @DATSTR AND @DATEND AND (H.DEPT = @DEPT OR @DEPT = '') ) SELECT * FROM MAIN_QUERY ORDER BY DOCNUM DESC,DOCLIN
